title: Component Representation Contract
description: v0.4.1-draft. Component-neutral. Corrected successor to v0.4.0-draft, whose bytes are pinned by checksum in the frozen research package and are therefore not reused (BP-3). Carries the v0.4 structural changes C-1..C-11 unchanged: layoutStrategy/matrixAllocations replaced by layoutRepresentations[] with typed dimensions and recomputable allocation evidence; component-hardcoded scope vocabulary replaced by typed appliesToScopes[] plus corroboration; theme binding remodelled around collection->mode provenance; coverage metrics discriminated; enumeration provenance structured; naming rules and operational node bindings added. Adds the 0.4.1 corrections: every rule, blocker, finding and known limitation carries a structured, resolvable `target`, and all free text is confined to a `narrative` object that no logic reads (D-1, D-2, D-3, D-7).

contractId.description: Stable identity for this contract document, unchanged across versions. Used as the scopeRef target for scopeType=contract.

migrationReportRef.description: Required (non-null) whenever authoringMode is 'migrated', EVEN IF no legacy state remains. Must be null when authoringMode is 'authored'. Enforced by CV-17 legs a/b.

buildFrameId.description: C-11: a many-to-one reference, NOT an identifier. Multiple component sets may share one build frame. CV-2 enforces uniqueness on id only, and separately that no buildFrameId equals any id.

appliesToScopes.description: C-10. Absent or empty means the mapping applies unscoped. CV-14 rejects two entries sharing (axis, canonicalValue) with overlapping effective scopes.

namingRules.description: Component-neutral layer-naming rules. Layer names are first-class contract data but are never the sole semantic or referential identity.

layoutRepresentations.description: C-1. Replaces scalar layoutStrategy and top-level matrixAllocations. Independently scoped; a component may carry several simultaneously. An empty array is the honest representation of 'no documentation'.

representationNodeBindings.description: The OPERATIONAL locator table. Node resolution goes exclusively through these bindings. layoutRepresentations[].evidenceNodeIds is provenance only and must never be used as a runtime locator.

undocumentedSchemaVariantIds.description: Schema variants that no layoutRepresentation covers. Silence must be explicit: CV-3b rejects a variant that is neither covered nor listed here.

appliesToScopes.description: C-3. Plural: a finding may span several component sets or families. Every scopeRef must resolve against the array named by its scopeType.

narrative.description: Human-readable prose only. No production code path reads any field under `narrative` as a reference; the normative reference is the sibling `target`.

knownLimitations.description: D-2 also had a knownLimitations twin. A limitation with no resolvable anchor cannot be checked against the corpus it describes, so each row names what it is about.

narrative.description: Human-readable prose only. No production code path reads any field under `narrative` as a reference; the normative reference is the sibling `target`.

authoringMode.description: How this contract came into existence. The discriminator that makes 'legacy states are migration-only' enforceable WITHOUT version-sniffing. 'authored' forbids every legacy_* state and every migrationReviewRequired flag.

evidenceLevel.description: How strongly a claim is backed. visual_matrix_verified and component_children_enumerated are deliberately NOT an ordered pair -- a screenshot never upgrades to enumeration; they are different kinds of check, not different strengths of the same check.

claimClassification.description: observed = read directly from source data. computed = derived deterministically from observed data. inferred = a plausible explanation not directly provable. unverified = could not be established.

readinessStatus.description: Component-neutral. 'validation_ready' means the package validates and is checksum-pinned; it is NOT production approval.

blockerClass.description: Lets CV-17 match an unresolved-migration artifact to its blocker without string matching.

scopeType.description: C-3. Names the array that scopeRef must resolve against. Deliberately excludes any cross-contract member: scope (what a finding applies to) is kept separate from corroboration (how broadly it has been observed).

migrationReviewRequired.description: Set by migration when the intended scope could not be inferred mechanically. NOT a passive marker: CV-17 leg f requires a matching approval blocker and forbids approved/ready_for_production.

corroborationLevel.description: single_component_observed = seen in the current contract only. multi_component_corroborated = the current contract PLUS at least one distinct external contract. owner_declared_standard = backed by a resolvable owner confirmation.

corroboratingContracts.description: External contracts only -- the current contract is implicit. A bare contract id is not sufficient evidence; each entry is hash-verified by CV-15.

evidenceRecord.description: An observation record. It carries NO generalization scope: generalization belongs on structuralFindings[].appliesToScopes / corroboration. Conflating the two was the v0.3.1 defect C-3 exists to fix.

propertyRole.description: C-9. Component-neutral Builder role, consistency-checked against the Figma property type.

overrideEvidenceStatus.description: C-9 tri-state. Replaces a bare boolean, which conflated 'checked and absent' with 'not inspected'.

treatment.description: C-8. Replaces the required non-nullable treatmentLabel string. No sentinel strings.

legacyMigrationState.description: Shared shape for every migration-only unresolved state. Governed by CV-17: forbidden when authoringMode=authored; blocks approval and production readiness; can never satisfy a completeness claim or make an allocation an approved Builder default.

dimension.description: C-2. Tagged union. No magic strings such as __treatment__.

allocationEvidenceStatus.description: C-4. 'verified' requires a recomputable artifact. 'legacy_unverified' is migration-only and governed by CV-17. No version-number-based exemption exists.

evidenceNodeIds.description: PROVENANCE ONLY. Never a runtime locator -- use representationNodeBindings[].

representationNodeBinding.description: The operational locator. containerNodeId is the node to act on; rootNodeId bounds the resolver's scoped fallback search.

namingRule.description: Layer names are first-class contract data (creation, location, conformity, renaming, update) but never the sole semantic or referential identity.

coverageMetric.description: C-5. matrix_cells is defined as rows x columns, EXCLUDING bands. legacy_unclassified preserves a value whose metric kind is unknown and is migration-only.

modeBinding.description: C-7. provenanceStatus is separate from provenance so migration never has to invent an out-of-enum provenance value.

themeContainer.description: Identity is containerNodeId, not containerNodeName -- container names are not unique. The research corpus contains a component with two containers both literally named "card".

descendantVariableUse.description: Variables bound by descendants are recorded separately from the container's collection->mode binding. The two are different facts.

targetKind.description: Names the collection that targetRef must resolve against. `artifact` resolves on disk; `contract_field` resolves as a JSON Pointer into this contract; `contract` is the document as a whole and takes the literal targetRef "self".

ruleTarget.description: The single normative reference of the row that carries it. This is the field logic reads; everything under `narrative` is prose and is read by nothing. Introduced because D-1, D-2, D-3 and D-7 were all load-bearing references that lived only in prose and therefore survived a fully green suite.

targetRef.description: The identifier, JSON Pointer or repository-relative path resolved against targetKind. Never a sentence.

requiredStrategy.description: Kind-compatibility for a layout_representation target. D-3 is exactly this: a matrix-cell rule whose target resolved to a list representation with no allocation key. Permitted only when targetKind is layout_representation.

requiredArtifactSha256.description: Content pin for an artifact target. Permitted only when targetKind is artifact.
